browse_local_protocols.description: Protocols used for local printer sharing.

browsing.description: Show shared printers on the local network.

default_auth_type.description: Default type of authentication, when authentication is required.

error_policy.description: What happens to a failed print job unless the printer says otherwise.

idle_exit_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before cupsd exits (only when it runs on demand, with -l).

listen_address.description: Address the scheduler listens on; "localhost" accepts only local connections, "*" or "0.0.0.0" all interfaces.

listen_port.description: TCP port the scheduler listens on (IPP).

log_level.description: Level of logging for the ErrorLog file; "none" stops all logging, "debug2" logs everything.

max_log_size.description: Maximum size of the log files before they are rotated (bytes, or with a k/m suffix); "0" disables rotation.
